title.en: Musa (AS) and al-Khadir: Beyond What We See
title.hi: Musa (AS) aur Khizr: Jo Nazar Nahi Aata

status: draft: to be checked by a scholar before public release

say.en: Musa, alaihis salam, one of the greatest prophets, travelled far to learn from a servant of Allah. And what he saw, the Quran has kept for us.
say.hi: Musa alaihis salam, Allah ke azeem paighambar, ek bande se ilm seekhne door tak gaye. Aur jo unhone dekha, woh Quran ne hamare liye mehfooz kar diya.

say.en: The Prophet, peace be upon him, told us: Musa was asked who was the most learned of people, and he said: I. So Allah told him: at the junction of the two seas is a servant of Mine who knows more than you.
say.hi: Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne bataya: Musa se poochha gaya ke logon mein sabse zyada ilm kiske paas hai, unhone kaha: mere paas. To Allah ne farmaya: do samundaron ke milne ki jagah mera ek banda hai jo tumse zyada jaanta hai.

heading.en: UNTIL I REACH | *WHERE TWO SEAS MEET*
heading.hi: JAB TAK DO SAMUNDAR | *MIL NA JAAYEIN*

say.en: Musa said to his young helper: I will not stop until I reach the meeting of the two seas, even if I travel for a long time.
say.hi: Musa ne apne naujawan saathi se kaha: main nahi rukunga jab tak do samundaron ke milne ki jagah na pahunch jaaun, chahe bahut lamba safar karna pade.

say.en: Allah had told him to take a fish: where he lost it, he would find that servant. At a rock by the sea, the fish slipped out and made its way into the sea.
say.hi: Allah ne unhein ek machli saath lene ko kaha tha: jahan machli kho jaaye, wahin woh banda milega. Samundar kinare ek chattan ke paas, machli nikal kar samundar mein apni raah chali gayi.

say.en: They travelled on, tired, and his helper remembered the fish. Musa said: that is what we were seeking. So they went back, following their own footsteps.
say.hi: Woh thak kar aage chalte rahe, phir saathi ko machli yaad aayi. Musa ne kaha: yahi to hum dhoondh rahe the. To woh apne qadmon ke nishaan par wapas laute.

say.en: There they found a servant of Allah, to whom Allah had given mercy, and taught knowledge from Himself. The Prophet, peace be upon him, called him al-Khadir.
say.hi: Wahan unhein Allah ka ek banda mila, jise Allah ne apni rehmat di thi, aur apne paas se ilm sikhaya tha. Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne unhein al-Khadir kaha, jinhein hum Khizr kehte hain.

heading.en: YOU WILL NEVER | *BE PATIENT WITH ME*
heading.hi: AAP MERE SAATH | *SABR NAHI KAR PAAYENGE*

say.en: Musa asked to follow him and learn. He said: you will never be patient with me. How can you be patient with what you do not fully know? Musa said: you will find me patient, if Allah wills.
say.hi: Musa ne saath chal kar seekhne ki ijazat maangi. Unhone kaha: aap mere saath sabr nahi kar paayenge. Jis cheez ka poora ilm na ho, us par sabr kaise karenge? Musa bole: in sha Allah, aap mujhe sabr karne wala paayenge.

say.en: Musa, alaihis salam, had promised to be patient. The condition was: ask nothing, until I tell you. They walked along the shore, and a boat's crew took them on board for free.
say.hi: Musa alaihis salam ne sabr ka waada kiya tha. Shart yeh thi: kuch mat poochhna, jab tak main khud na bataun. Woh kinare chale, aur ek kashti walon ne unhein muft sawar kar liya.

say.en: A small bird dipped its beak into the sea. Al-Khadir said: Musa, my knowledge and yours have taken from Allah's knowledge only as much as this bird has taken from the sea.
say.hi: Ek chhoti chidiya ne samundar mein chonch daali. Khizr ne kaha: Musa, mera aur aapka ilm, Allah ke ilm mein se utna hi hai jitna is chidiya ne samundar se liya.

heading.en: HE MADE A HOLE | *IN THE BOAT*

say.en: Then al-Khadir tore a plank out of the boat. Musa said: have you holed it to drown its people? You have done a grave thing. He replied: did I not say you would not be patient with me?
say.hi: Phir Khizr ne kashti ka ek takhta nikaal diya. Musa bole: kya aapne iske logon ko dubone ke liye suraakh kiya? Yeh to bada sangeen kaam hai. Unhone kaha: kya maine nahi kaha tha ke aap sabr nahi kar paayenge?

say.en: They went on and met a boy, and al-Khadir killed him. Musa said: have you killed a pure soul, who killed no one? Then Musa said: if I ask again, do not keep me with you.
say.hi: Woh aage chale aur ek ladka mila, aur Khizr ne use maar diya. Musa bole: kya aapne ek begunah jaan le li, jisne kisi ko qatl nahi kiya? Phir Musa ne kaha: agar main phir poochhun, to mujhe saath na rakhna.

say.en: In a town whose people refused them food, there was a wall about to fall, and al-Khadir set it right. Musa said: you could have taken a payment for it. He said: this is where we part.
say.hi: Ek basti mein, jahan logon ne unhein khaana tak na diya, ek deewar girne wali thi, aur Khizr ne use seedha kar diya. Musa bole: aap iski mazdoori le sakte the. Unhone kaha: ab hamari judaai hai.

say.en: The boat belonged to poor people working at sea, and after them came a king seizing every good boat by force, so he damaged it. The boy's parents were believers, and it was feared he would burden them with rebellion and disbelief, so their Lord would give them one better.
say.hi: Kashti gareeb logon ki thi jo samundar mein kaam karte the, aur unke peechhe ek baadshah tha jo har achhi kashti zabardasti cheen leta tha, isliye usmein aib daala. Ladke ke maa baap momin the, aur dar tha ke woh unhein sarkashi aur kufr mein phansa dega, to unka Rabb unhein usse behtar de.

say.en: The wall belonged to two orphan boys, with their treasure beneath it, and their father had been righteous. It was a mercy from your Lord. And he said: I did not do it of my own accord.
say.hi: Deewar do yateem ladkon ki thi, uske neeche unka khazana tha, aur unka baap nek tha. Yeh tumhare Rabb ki rehmat thi. Aur unhone kaha: maine yeh apni marzi se nahi kiya.

heading.en: WHEN IT MAKES NO SENSE, | *ALLAH KNOWS*
heading.hi: JAB SAMAJH NA AAYE, | *ALLAH JAANTA HAI*

say.en: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: may Allah have mercy on Musa; we wished he had been patient, so we would be told more. When something in your life makes no sense, remember the boat, the boy and the wall.
say.hi: Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya: Allah Musa par rehem kare, kaash woh sabr karte to hamein aur bataya jaata. Jab zindagi mein kuch samajh na aaye, to kashti, ladke aur deewar ko yaad karna.

heading.en: SEND THIS TO SOMEONE | *WHO NEEDS SABR*

say.en: Send this to someone who is waiting for something to make sense.
say.hi: Yeh video usay bhejein, jo kisi baat ke samajh aane ka intezaar kar raha hai.
